source: Own measurement on the fixed hidden set (tests/hidden/episodes.json: draw 1, 12 episodes, 2 per unit): the privileged reference (solution/solve.sh, token truth) through the pinned engine (vendor/ale bfb7505), mean_episode_credit 1.0, every unit 1.0.
